title: Build Biology Sentences: Structure and Function
objective: Students connect biological structures to their functions using reliable sentence patterns.
outcomes: Use has, contains, consists of, and is located in.
Combine two simple ideas with because.
Move from word to phrase to full sentence.
activity: Describe the job of a cell part. Identify the part from a partner’s clue.
example: The nucleus contains DNA. The main function of the cell membrane is to control movement into and out of the cell.
